highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 will improve filtered-image and glyph rendering without changing public APIs.
highlights_body: The upcoming update prevents sampling outside intended image subsets and corrects image-filter cache-key comparisons.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered images within texture subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects subset sampling under minification, strong skew, antialiasing clips, and multisampling. Logical texture bounds and strict sampling constraints for transparent borders prevent unrelated backing-store pixels from leaking into filtered images.

Aligns image-filter cache-key equality with its bytewise hash, accounting for signed-zero representations, matrix type metadata, and subnormal values so lookup and LRU eviction use consistent key identity.

Uses the reloaded glyph's own outline when font-scaler loads disagree. Clears incompatible masks before overlap copies and preserves full plane strides for clipped emboss masks, avoiding stale outlines, format assertions, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and uncleared mask planes.
